disposition_reason: Forty-two supermarket hen eggs from Tehran were analysed for lead and cadmium by ICP-MS; Table 2 gives range, minimum, maximum and mean ± SE.

study.design: Retail survey of hen eggs with Monte Carlo risk assessment
study.method: Drying at 70 °C, HNO3/H2O2 digestion (150 °C, 4 h); ICP-MS (PerkinElmer Elan 6100 DRC-e)
study.lod_text: LOD/LOQ not stated; values below LOQ set to LOQ/2 for statistics

findings.material_label: Hen eggs (whole egg contents, shell removed)
findings.group: supermarket eggs from best-selling brands, Tehran
findings.notes: ± is SE (0.248 µg/kg). Basis unclear: whole egg contents were dried 24 h at 70 °C before digestion, yet Section 2.7 says results are per kg moist weight. Text (p. 2886) gives 7.158 ± 0.240.
